text: Control what agents can do on behalf of each user. Enforce policy, keep credentials private, and audit every action. Without Alter Pasted into prompts, configs, and .env files across every repo. Every agent borrows the same over-scoped credential. Nobody can say which agent did what, or on whose behalf. With Alter Stored once and injected per request, so proxied calls keep it out of your code. Each agent gets its own identity and scopes, with a human gate where you want one. A tamper-evident trail with a name attached to every call. Building agents Securing agents One SDK call handles storage, refresh, policy, and audit for 140 providers. First-class LangChain, MCP, and AWS integrations. Four features on a single request path. Store credentials once. Agents use them without ever seeing them. Each request checked against your rules. Deny by default. Per-agent keys and scopes, traceable to a real person. Sensitive calls wait for a named person. Everything else flows. A record you can hand to an auditor, streamed to your SIEM. The full request path, end to end, on one page. Every card is a working guide with code. Run OAuth, Connect, and identity-aware token retrieval end to end. The agent gets its own identity, its user grants, and its own audit trail. Store API keys and service tokens in Alter instead of environment variables. Build your own MCP server that serves Alter-managed credentials as tools. Key memory, sessions, and channels by verified identity, never by what the LLM claims. Serve many users from one service without the credential entering your process. Our trust center publishes the live state of our security program: monitored controls, an independent penetration test within the last 12 months, and security policy documents on request. Book a 30-minute walkthrough with the founders. Required for sign-in, security, authorization, and remembering your choices. Helps us understand which product and documentation features are useful. Uses performance tracing and privacy-masked session replay to diagnose problems. You can change these choices at any time from Cookie settings.
